highlights.title: Sign-ins that fit your phone
highlights.line: Take over an agent's page and it fits your phone: tap, type, paste, give back.

fixes: Screen shows one agent at a time, full size, with one switch: Take over or Give back.
Zoomed in on Screen, one finger moves the view; tap twice to zoom, press and hold for right click, double click or drag.
The floating screen is for watching: tap it to open Screen.
Typing fast on Screen sends each letter once, and the keys you need stay above the keyboard.
